{
  "name": "next-up",
  "version": "1.0.1",
  "description": "Keeps the follow-ups Claude suggests in one backlog shared by every session, and a checklist Claude keeps for multi-step work in each session, each with a footer button and a pane",
  "author": {
    "name": "Alec McLeod",
    "url": "https://github.com/aosmcleod"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/aosmcleod/next-up-mod#readme",
  "repository": "https://github.com/aosmcleod/next-up-mod",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "backlog",
    "tasks",
    "todo",
    "checklist",
    "follow-up",
    "sessions",
    "productivity"
  ],
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/aosmcleod/next-up-mod#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/aosmcleod/next-up-mod/issues",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "backlog": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Next Up backlog",
      "description": "Collect Claude's suggested follow-ups into one backlog across sessions, with the Next Up footer button and pane.",
      "default": true
    },
    "tasks": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Session tasks",
      "description": "Have Claude keep a task list for multi-step work in each session, with the Tasks footer button and pane.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
